notes:
Passed on the fake backend with python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/pymeasure__pymeasure --backend fake: all nine gates pass, the check report carries no warnings, and the evidence state is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null, the hardware backend (native.py, a pymeasure VISA resource) was never opened and no instrument was attached. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's helper is PythonObjectDriver (family python-object), but a measurement action configures a mode through one upstream method and then reads a second property (:READ?), and the native stop is the upstream scan_stop(); a family command table cannot express that, so the package is a direct Driver over the upstream class with a native.py factory (the card's decision is direct-driver). DRIVER PACK: the card lists five entry symbols for the repository; recon confirmed all five exist and picked the first, pymeasure.instruments.keithley.keithleyDMM6500:KeithleyDMM6500, because it is the class that matches the card's candidate classes (cap.measure.current.v1, cap.measure.resistance.v1, cap.measure.voltage.v1, cap.device.configure.v1) and its instrument.dmm resource plan. The other four entry symbols (HP8561B at hp856Xx.py:3039, HP8560A at hp856Xx.py:2836, SFM at rohdeschwarz/sfm.py:192, AgilentB2987 at agilent/agilentB298x.py:1132) are not covered by this package. MOCK PATH: the card's mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim (pymeasure/adapters/adapter.py:226 FakeAdapter, pymeasure/instruments/fakes.py:35 FakeInstrument), but the clone is read-only and is never imported or run, and pymeasure is not installed in the sandbox, so the package fake (fake.py) is an in-memory stand-in instead: it defines only methods and properties of the upstream class that gate G7 checks against the clone's AST, and its starting values are placeholder test data, not device facts. COVERED: reads mode, nplc and digits; the write nplc, limited 0.0005 to 15 by the upstream nplc control (keithleyDMM6500.py:365); cap.measure.voltage.v1 (dc), cap.measure.current.v1 (range_a, limited 10e-6 to 10 A from the upstream current_range docstring, keithleyDMM6500.py:494-495) and cap.measure.resistance.v1 (four_wire); the e-stop and the declared safe state are the native scan_stop() (:ABOR, keithleyDMM6500.py:1315-1321); teardown closes the connection (KeithleyDMM6500.close, keithleyDMM6500.py:238). NOT COVERED: the temperature, frequency, period, capacitance, diode and continuity measurement modes of the same class, the scanner-card channels (ScannerCard2000Channel), scan_start/scan_count/scan_interval and the reading buffer beyond the abort, the binary data path (read_binary_values/write_binary_values), display, beep and the AC measurement ranges; the hardware path and the wire syntax were never run against an instrument, and the fake is not a recording of one. FACTS AND LIMITS: the 11 Facts and 2 Limits all cite lines of the clone at the pinned commit 9c6a96014e74bda79988ae0757a6b38ca390d247 and the gate reports no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning; the clone's docs are PDFs and none were read or cited. check-report.json is generated by the gate run and is not part of the authored package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted after a reviewer edit: native.py no longer says that the loader refuses this R1 hardware backend until reviewed_by is signed (the loader refuses only R2 and above). After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
